dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow V-shape where the posterior edge of the band tapers downward at the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible upper torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant distance between pinnae, approximately three times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The right pinna exhibits a smooth, rounded semi-circular apex; the left pinna appears slightly more flattened or angled due to the head orientation.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow soil staining or fur discoloration localized on the lower lumbar and rump region.
